answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow blocks mass forgery. Each identity enters through one narrow inlet, locking 20 POA in escrow. In 30 days the network logs timing and peers; like karst carved slowly by water, a fingerprint forms only from real work, layer by layer like a pearl. Deposit unlocks in three parts once the print steadies. Forging 1,000 identities locks 20,000 POA, against 30 POA each. Honest agents pay once, keep the full reward.
